seo.title: Privacy Notice
seo.description: Privacy notice of the Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC) governing the use of certificacionmontessori.com.

intro.p1: <blanco>At the Asociación Montessori de México A.C., </blanco>we care about our users' privacy, and we are committed to protecting the personal information you provide to us. Please review our privacy notice and the terms and conditions of use of our website.

fundamento.titulo: Legal basis for the processing of personal data
fundamento.p1: Articles 6, Section A, subsections II and III, and 16, second paragraph, of the Political Constitution of the United Mexican States; and Articles 3 (Section XXXIII), 16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 26, 27, 28, 48, 49, 51, 52, and 86 of the Ley General de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de Sujetos Obligados (LGPDPPSO, Mexico's general law on the protection of personal data held by regulated entities);

recopilamos.p1: For statistical analysis and to improve the user experience, the Asociación Montessori reserves the right to collect and process the following data. Information provided voluntarily: personal information submitted through forms on the Site, such as your name, email address, telephone number, and postal address, as well as additional information such as your interests and preferences. Automatic information: when you use the site https://certificacionmontessori.com/, data about your device and your use of the Site may be collected automatically, such as your IP address, the type of browser you use, the pages of the Site you visit, and the dates and times of access, as well as information about your browsing habits and preferences through the use of cookies and other tracking technologies.

uso.p1: The information collected through the Site is used to provide and improve our services, as well as to carry out the following activities. Providing information about products and services: the information collected is used to send you information about products and services, with the option to unsubscribe from this service at any time. Your experience on the Site is also personalized according to your interests and preferences. Marketing communications: if you have subscribed to our mailing list or otherwise given your consent, the information collected is used to send marketing and promotional communications. You are always offered the option to opt out of receiving these communications. Site analysis and improvement: the information collected is used to analyze and improve the performance of the Site and the services offered. Troubleshooting: information is collected in order to resolve issues and address any questions or concerns that may arise.

compartimos.p1: Entities belonging to the Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC): the information collected may be shared with entities belonging to AMMAC in order to provide services and improve the user experience. The Asociación Montessori shares information with third parties only in the following circumstances. With our service providers: we may share information with third parties that provide services to us, such as payment processors (for example, Stripe, for online payments of enrollment fees and publications) and analytics service providers.
compartimos.nota: Note: all third parties with whom we share information are required to comply with applicable data privacy and security laws. We do not allow our service providers to use your personal information for their own purposes, and we only allow them to process your personal information for specific purposes and in accordance with our instructions.
compartimos.p2: For legal purposes: we may share information if we believe in good faith that doing so is necessary to comply with the law or to protect our rights or those of third parties. In the event of a merger or acquisition: if we sell or acquire a company or assets, we may share information with the buyer or seller.

modificaciones.p1: This privacy notice may be modified or updated from time to time. Any updates or modifications will be made available to the public, and the data subject may consult them on the website https://certificacionmontessori.com/, in the Privacy Notice section. Data subjects are advised and expected to review this Privacy Notice at least every six months in order to stay informed of its terms and conditions.

arco.titulo: Exercising your ARCO rights (Access, Rectification, Cancellation, and Objection to the use of your personal data)
arco.p1: You have the right to know what personal data we hold about you, what we use it for, and the conditions under which we use it (Access). You also have the right to request the correction of your personal information if it is outdated, inaccurate, or incomplete (Rectification); to request that we delete it from our records or databases when you consider that it is not being used appropriately (Cancellation); and to object to the use of your personal data for specific purposes (Objection). These are known as the ARCO rights under Mexican data protection law. To exercise your rights of access, rectification, cancellation, and objection (ARCO rights), you may visit the offices of the Asociación Montessori at Av. Dos 48, San Pedro de los Pinos, Benito Juárez, 03800 Mexico City, Mexico. The decision reached will be communicated to you within a maximum of 30 business days from the date the request was received so that, if it is granted, it can be carried out within the following fifteen business days after the response is communicated. You may revoke any consent you have given us for the processing of your personal data. However, please bear in mind that we will not be able to grant every request or end the processing immediately in all cases, since a legal obligation may require us to continue processing your personal data. You should also consider that, for certain purposes, revoking your consent will mean that we can no longer provide the online service you requested, or that your relationship with us will come to an end.

seo.title: Refund Policy
seo.description: Conditions for requesting refunds on enrollment fees, tuition, books, and training materials at the Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC).

intro.p1: The Asociación Montessori de México A.C. (AMMAC) offers online payments for enrollment fees, tuition, books, and training materials. The conditions under which refunds may be requested are described below.

s1.titulo: 1. Enrollment in diploma courses and training programs
s1.p1: If you request a refund within 5 calendar days of payment and before the program's start date, 100% of the amount paid as an enrollment fee is refunded. After that period, the enrollment fee is non-refundable, but it may be transferred to a future cohort, subject to availability and to the decision of the academic coordination office.

s2.p1: Monthly tuition is charged in advance for the current period. Once the corresponding month has begun, tuition is non-refundable. Recurring subscriptions can be canceled at any time from the student portal; cancellation prevents future charges but does not generate a refund for the current month.

s3.p1: Physical books may be returned within 7 calendar days of receiving the product, provided it is in its original condition (unused, unmarked, and in its original packaging). Return shipping costs are borne by the buyer, except in cases of a damaged product or a shipping error attributable to AMMAC.
s3.p2: Ebooks and downloadable digital materials are non-refundable once the download has been completed, given their intangible and immediate nature.

s4.p1: If you detect a duplicate charge or a technical error that resulted in an incorrect charge, write to us as soon as possible. These cases are resolved with a full refund within no more than 5 business days from confirmation of the error.

s5.titulo: 5. How do I request a refund?
lista: Full name of the student or buyer.
Order number or payment reference (you will find it in your Stripe confirmation email or in your records on the student portal).
s5.p2: You can also contact us on WhatsApp at <linkWhatsapp>55 4888 5013</linkWhatsapp> from 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. (Mexico City time), or by phone at <linkTelefono>55 5515 2701</linkTelefono>.

s6.p1: Once a refund is approved, the amount is returned to the original payment method. For credit or debit cards, the time it takes to appear on the customer's statement depends on the issuing bank and may range from 5 to 15 business days. AMMAC processes the refund immediately through Stripe; crediting times are determined by the bank.

s7.p1: Online payments are processed by Stripe Payments Mexico in compliance with PCI-DSS data security standards. AMMAC does not store card information in its systems.

s8.p1: This policy may be updated at any time. Changes are published on this same page. The date of the last update appears at the bottom of this document.
